name: ngx-json-render-ui
description: Renders interactive dashboards, forms, tables and status pages inline in the chat as Angular Material components.

interface.longDescription:
Ask for a dashboard, a form, a status summary or a comparison, and see it as a real interface instead of a wall of text. ChatGPT describes the UI as a json-render spec, and the render-ui tool draws it inline in the chat with Angular Material: metric tiles, tables, cards, tabs, lists, progress bars, callouts, and forms with inputs, selects, checkboxes and validation. Form fields and buttons are live inside the view, so you can fill in a form and see validation messages without another round trip.

The tool is read-only. It shows data that is already in the conversation; it does not connect to your systems or store anything. A button can post your choice or a filled-in form to the chat as your message, so ChatGPT continues from what you clicked. No account or sign-in is needed.

Built on json-render, the open generative-UI format from Vercel Labs, and ngx-json-render, its open-source Angular renderer (Apache-2.0).
capabilities: Render dashboards with metric tiles and tables
Render status pages, cards, tabs and lists
Post a button press or a filled-in form to the chat
defaultPrompt: Show me a dashboard of our Q3 sales by region
Create a sign-up form for our beta with validation
Compare the three hosting plans side by side

positive.description: Dashboard from figures given in the prompt. Select ngx-json-render UI with @ in the message box first (type @ngx and press Return); without it ChatGPT answers with its own charts.
positive.prompt: Show a dashboard of our Q3 sales by region: North America $2.1M, Europe $1.3M, Asia-Pacific $0.9M, Latin America $0.5M
positive.expected_behavior: An inline view with at least one metric tile (such as total sales of $4.8M) and a table or list with the four regions and the figures given. ChatGPT may also mention the figures in its text reply.

positive.description: Form with validation. Select ngx-json-render UI with @ first (type @ngx and press Return).
positive.prompt: Create a beta sign-up form with a required name field and a required email field, with validation
positive.expected_behavior: An inline form with a Name field and an Email field, possibly with further fields. Click into the Email field, type not-an-email and click outside it: a validation message appears under the field, without another model turn.

positive.description: Status page from facts given in the prompt. Select ngx-json-render UI with @ first (type @ngx and press Return).
positive.prompt: Show the status of the mobile app release: 70% complete, iOS build passed, Android QA in progress, main risk is a crash on Android sign-in
positive.expected_behavior: An inline status view that shows the 70% completion (as a progress bar or a figure), the iOS build and Android QA states, and the Android sign-in crash as the main risk.

positive.description: Side-by-side comparison of plans given in the prompt. Select ngx-json-render UI with @ first (type @ngx and press Return).
positive.prompt: Compare these hosting plans side by side: Starter $5/mo with 1 site, Pro $20/mo with 10 sites, Business $80/mo with unlimited sites
positive.expected_behavior: An inline view that shows the three plans side by side (as cards or table columns), each with the price and site count given.

positive.description: Table from data in the prompt. Select ngx-json-render UI with @ first (type @ngx and press Return).
positive.prompt: Show these as a table: Alice 34 Berlin, Bob 29 Lisbon, Chen 41 Taipei
positive.expected_behavior: An inline table with Name, Age and City columns and exactly the three rows given, with no invented rows. ChatGPT may repeat the same rows in its text reply.

negative.description: A factual question needs no UI: ChatGPT answers in plain text and does not call render-ui.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?

negative.description: Creative writing needs no UI: ChatGPT answers in plain text and does not call render-ui.
A translation needs no UI: ChatGPT answers in plain text and does not call render-ui.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: one read-only tool, render-ui, that draws a json-render spec inline as Angular Material components, with live forms and a button action that posts a message to the chat.
